name: Mystore
description:
Mystore is a full-stack, AI-powered marketplace platform for Indian sellers and brands, built by Hippo Innovations. This connector lets you securely access your own Mystore store data from Claude using read-only tools.

Once connected, ask Claude things like:
- "Show me my latest products," or "find published gift hampers that are in stock."
- "What were my total sales in 2025?"
- "List my most recent orders and their payment status."
- "Pull up the full details of order OID1257195."
- "How many customers do I have, and who are the latest?"
- "What collections do I have?"
- "How do I set up a payment gateway?" — answered from Mystore's help docs.

Key features:
- Search and view products, collections, orders, and customers
- Run natural-language analytics queries (sales totals, orders by status, top products, and more)
- Search grounded Mystore help documentation

The connector is fully read-only — Claude can look up and summarize your store data but can never create, edit, delete, or place anything in your store. Sign-in uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE; your Mystore password is never shared with Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mystore to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mystore to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.mystore.in/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mystore MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mystore provides these MCP tools: www_mystore_in__analytics-query, www_mystore_in__get-collection, www_mystore_in__get-customer, www_mystore_in__get-order, www_mystore_in__get-product, www_mystore_in__help-search, www_mystore_in__list-customers, www_mystore_in__list-orders, www_mystore_in__search-collections, and www_mystore_in__search-products.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mystore?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mystore in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Mystore requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mystore is developed by Mystore. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
